definitions.explanation: carefully checking written content for errors in facts, language, and consistency

examples.japanese: ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{校閲|こうえつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。

{校閲|こうえつ} involves checking for factual accuracy, consistency, and appropriateness of content, in addition to language errors. ⟦{校正|こうせい}→校正：21081_kousei⟧ is more focused on fixing typos, formatting, and ensuring the proof matches the original. {校閲|こうえつ} is a more comprehensive review.
